_meta.note: ModelLeague state. One record per league in `leagues`; the weekly tick (phase 2) appends to each league's `weeks` and updates `standings`. v0 is preseason: pools are provisional, no scores exist yet.

site.name: ModelLeague
site.tagline: Fantasy football, but for large language models.
site.contact: open an issue on the repo with your team name, or message Colton directly

frontier.name: Frontier League
frontier.slugline: Closed lab models — the flagships you can only use through an API.
frontier.pool_status: Provisional — frozen at the Season 1 draft. The pool is assembled from the data feeds at draft time; a model that ships after the draft hits the waiver wire instead.

open.name: Open Source League
open.slugline: Open-weight models — the ones you can download and run yourself.
open.pool_status: Provisional — frozen at the Season 1 draft. The pool is assembled from the data feeds at draft time; a model that ships after the draft hits the waiver wire instead.

index_components.label: Quality
index_components.plain: How well the model does on the standard tests — the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, blended with LMArena Elo (the crowd-sourced head-to-head vote).

index_components.label: Value
index_components.plain: How much you get per dollar. A cheap model that is nearly as good scores high. This is the sleeper lane.

index_components.label: Momentum
index_components.plain: Week-over-week movement in the composite. A model that is climbing gets a boost; one that is fading gets docked.

index_components.label: Adoption
index_components.plain: Download and usage growth, from the Hugging Face API (open models) or vendor announcements (frontier). Capped, so hype cannot dominate.

events.event: New release or major update (one-time debut bonus)
Major incident (outage, recall, or scandal in the press)
